rules.nameCn: G.EXP.02 判断相等时应使用 === 和 !== ，而不是 == 和 !=

rules.nameCn: G.EXP.01 表达式的比较，应该遵循左侧倾向于变化、右侧倾向于不变的原则

rules.nameCn: G.NAM.03 变量应采用小驼峰风格命名

rules.name: G.ERR.03 Do not use return, break, continue or throw exception to abruptly terminate the finally block
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.03 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束

rules.name: G.NAM.02 Name functions in lower camel case
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.02 函数应采用小驼峰风格命名

rules.name: G.ERR.02 Use Error objects as Promise rejection reasons
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.02 应使用 Error 对象作为 Promise 拒绝的原因

rules.name: G.NAM.01 Name constructors and classes in upper camel case
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.01 构造器函数、类应采用大驼峰风格命名

rules.name: G.ERR.01 Use exceptions properly
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.01 合理使用异常

rules.name: G.MOD.01 The variable to be exported must be of the immutable type
rules.nameCn: G.MOD.01 需要导出的变量必须是不可变的类型

rules.name: G.CTL.07 Avoid including too many conditions in a condition/loop control statement
rules.nameCn: G.CTL.07 避免在条件/循环控制语句中包含过多的条件

rules.name: G.MET.12 Use arrow functions instead of anonymous functions to replace the method of holding the this reference
rules.nameCn: G.MET.12 用到匿名函数时优先使用箭头函数，替代保存this引用的方式

rules.name: G.TYP.09 Do not remove or add elements during array traversal
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.09 不要在数组遍历中对其进行元素的 remove/add 操作

rules.name: G.CTL.06 Do not perform an assignment in a controlling conditional expression
rules.nameCn: G.CTL.06 不要在控制性条件表达式中执行赋值操作

rules.name: G.MET.11 Prefer destructuring from function parameters
rules.nameCn: G.MET.11 建议使用参数的解构

rules.name: G.TYP.08 Prefer using methods of Array object for array traversal
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.08 数组遍历优先使用 Array 对象方法

rules.name: G.CTL.05 Avoid using logical operators to replace control statements
rules.nameCn: G.CTL.05 避免用逻辑运算符代替控制语句

rules.name: G.MET.10 Use rest parameters instead of arguments
rules.nameCn: G.MET.10 不要使用 arguments，可以选择 rest 语法替代

rules.nameCn: G.TYP.07 不要在数组上定义或使用非数字属性（length 除外）

rules.name: G.MET.09 Do not reassign values to function parameters
rules.nameCn: G.MET.09 不要给函数的入参重新赋值

rules.nameCn: G.TYP.06 不应使用字符串的行连续符号

rules.nameCn: G.MET.08 不要动态创建函数

rules.nameCn: G.TYP.05 使用模板字符串（`）实现字符串拼接

rules.nameCn: G.WST.02 如果数据仅需要临时存储在客户端，使用非持久性会话cookie或者sessionStorage而不是localStorage

rules.name: G.MET.07 Use consistent return clauses
rules.nameCn: G.MET.07 建议使用一致的 return 语句

rules.name: G.TYP.04 Use single quotes to define strings
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.04 建议字符串使用单引号

rules.nameCn: G.CTL.02 在 switch 语句的每一个有内容的 case 中都应放置一条 break 语句

rules.nameCn: G.WST.01 禁止在 localStorage和sessionStorage中存储敏感数据

rules.name: G.TYP.03  Do not directly use == or === to determine the equivalence of floating point data
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.03 浮点型数据判断相等不要直接使用== 或===

rules.name: G.CTL.01 A switch statement must have a default branch
rules.nameCn: G.CTL.01 每个 switch 语句都应包含一个 default 分支

rules.name: G.WSQ.01 Do not store any sensitive data in Web SQL database and Indexed database
rules.nameCn: G.WSQ.01 禁止在 Web SQL database和Indexed database数据库中存储敏感数据

rules.name: G.MET.06 Enforce default parameters to be last
rules.nameCn: G.MET.06 始终将默认参数放在最后

rules.nameCn: G.CORS.01 使用postMessage方法实现跨域时，应严格校验Origin

rules.name: G.DCL.07  Avoid variable declarations from shadowing variables declared in the outer scope
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.07 避免当前作用域中的变量覆盖更外层作用域的变量

rules.name: G.MET.05 The number of function arguments should be no more than 5
rules.nameCn: G.MET.05 函数的参数个数不建议超过 5 个

rules.name: G.TYP.02 Must calling to isNaN() when checking for NaN
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.02 判断变量是否为NaN时必须使用 isNaN() 方法

rules.name: G.CMT.04 File header comments should contain the copyright notice
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.04 文件头注释包含版权说明

rules.name: G.DCL.06 Use literal-style declarations
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.06 使用字面量风格的声明

rules.name: G.MET.03 The maximum nesting depth of a block statement should not exceed 4 layers
rules.nameCn: G.MET.03 块语句的最大可嵌套深度不要超过 4 层

rules.nameCn: G.MET.04 回调函数嵌套的层数不超过 4 层

rules.name: G.TYP.01 Do not omit 0s before and after floating point decimals.
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.01 禁止省略浮点数小数点前后的 0

rules.name: G.CMT.03 No TODO/FIXME comments should be contained in the code delivered to customers
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.03 正式交付给客户的代码不应包含 TODO/FIXME 注释

rules.name: G.DCL.05 Avoid initializing variables to undefined
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.05 不要使用 undefined 初始化变量

rules.name: G.MET.02 Cyclomatic Complexity should not exceed 20
rules.nameCn: G.MET.02 圈复杂度不超过 20

rules.name: G.SCO.01 Do not declare variables or functions in the global scope
rules.nameCn: G.SCO.01 避免在全局作用域下声明变量和函数

rules.name: G.CMT.02 There should be a space between the comment character and the comment content
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.02 注释符和注释内容之间留有一个空格

rules.name: G.DCL.04 Do not use chained assignment expressions
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.04 禁止连续赋值

rules.name: G.MET.01 The length of the function should not be too long
rules.nameCn: G.MET.01 函数长度不宜过长

rules.name: G.PRJ.03 Control the length of the file, preferably no more than 2000 lines
rules.nameCn: G.PRJ.03 控制文件的长度，最好不要超过 2000 行

rules.name: G.CMT.01 Comments should be positioned above or beside code
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.01 代码注释置于对应代码的上方或右边

rules.name: G.DCL.03 Declare one variable in each line
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.03 每个语句只声明一个变量

rules.name: G.FMT.12 Statements should end with semicolons
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.12 每句代码后加分号

rules.name: G.PRJ.01 Source files (including comments) should be encoded in UTF-8 format
rules.nameCn: G.PRJ.01 源文件编码格式（包括注释）应该是 UTF-8

rules.name: G.AOD.05 Do not use debugger
rules.nameCn: G.AOD.05 禁止使用 debugger

rules.nameCn: G.DCL.01 声明变量时要求使用 const 或 let 而不是 var（ECMAScript 6）

rules.name: G.FMT.11 Use trailing commas

rules.nameCn: G.OTH.05 禁止代码中包含公网地址

rules.nameCn: G.TYP.15 其它类型转化为数字使用Number()，并且应显式检查返回值是否为NaN

rules.name: G.FMT.10 The opening brace should be palced at the end of a line

rules.name: G.OTH.04 Delete developers' personal information from official code and comments
rules.nameCn: G.OTH.04 正式发布的代码及注释内容不应包含开发者个人信息

rules.name: G.AOD.04 Do not use alert
rules.nameCn: G.AOD.04 禁止使用 alert

rules.name: G.OTH.03 Delete unused code segments instead of commenting them out

rules.name: G.AOD.03 Avoid using console

rules.name: G.TYP.14  Use explicit type conversions

rules.name: G.AOD.02 Do not use implied eval()
rules.nameCn: G.AOD.02 禁止使用隐式的 eval()

rules.nameCn: G.TYP.11 使用展开语法 … 或concat复制数组

rules.name: G.TYP.10 Prefer using destructuring from array

rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.06 需要约束 for-in

rules.name: G.OBJ.01 Use parentheses when invoking a constructor with new keyword
rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.01 通过 new 调用构造函数时，应始终使用圆括号

rules.name: G.EXP.06 Prefer using named capture group in regular expression
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.06 建议在正则表达式中使用命名捕获组

rules.name: G.OTH.06 Do not expose unnecessary information on UIs or in logs
rules.nameCn: G.OTH.06 禁止在用户界面、日志中暴露不必要信息

rules.name: G.EXP.05 The number of repeated whitespace characters should be explicitly indicated in regular expression literals
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.05 正则表达式字面量中，应显式指出重复的空白字符个数

rules.name: G.NOD.04 Perform security checks before file decompression
rules.nameCn: G.NOD.04 解压文件必须进行安全检查

rules.name: G.NAM.07 Follow a consistent file naming style and the file extension should be lower case
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.07 使用统一的文件命名风格，文件扩展名应小写

rules.name: G.EXP.04 Use parentheses to clarify the precedence of operations when different operators are mixed
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.04 在混合使用不同的操作符时，采用括号明确运算的优先级

rules.name: G.NAM.05 Do not use reserved words as variable names. Synonyms of reserved words are acceptable
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.05 不要用保留字做为变量名，可使用保留字的同义词

rules.name: G.EXP.03 Avoid nested ternary expressions
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.03 禁止使用嵌套的三元表达式

rules.name: G.ERR.07 A maximum of 5 exceptions can be thrown by one method. Record exceptions and their conditions in the @throws annotation of Javadoc
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.07 一个方法不应抛出超过5个异常，并在Javadoc的@throws标签中记录每个抛出的异常及其条件

rules.name: G.CON.01 Avoid synchronization pitfalls when implementing synchronization control on shared variables
rules.nameCn: G.CON.01 对共享变量做同步访问控制时需避开同步陷阱

rules.name: G.DCL.02 Local variables are declared close to the line where they are first used
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.02 局部变量被声明在接近它们首次使用的行

rules.name: G.PRM.07 Release resources in try-with-resource or finally during I/O operations
rules.nameCn: G.PRM.07 进行IO类操作时，必须在try-with-resource或finally里关闭资源

rules.name: G.OBJ.07 When child classes override methods of parent classes or implement interfaces
rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.07 子类覆写父类方法或实现接口时必须加上@Override注解

rules.name: G.TYP.08 Use Locale.ROOT or Locale.ENGLISH for conversion between uppercase and lowercase strings and formatting to Western Arabic numerals
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.08 字符串大小写转换、数字格式化为西方数字时，必须加上Locale.ROOT或Locale.ENGLISH

rules.name: G.SEC.04 Protect sensitive operations by a security manager
rules.nameCn: G.SEC.04 使用安全管理器来保护敏感操作

rules.name: G.EXP.06 Do not use asserts in code
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.06 代码中不应使用断言（assert）

rules.name: G.DCL.04 Avoid generating serial numbers of enumeration constants based on the ordinal() method
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.04 避免枚举常量序号的产生依赖于ordinal()方法

rules.name: G.PRM.08 Do not use active GC (unless in password and RMI)
rules.nameCn: G.PRM.08 禁止使用主动GC（除非在密码、RMI等方面），尤其是在频繁/周期性的逻辑中

rules.name: G.OBJ.05 Avoid overloading of primitive types and their boxed primitives
rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.05 避免基本类型与其包装类型的同名重载方法

rules.name: G.TYP.07 Do not hardcode the characters that indicate new lines and file path separators--hard-code line break
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.07 避免在代码中硬编码用于表示换行、文件路径分隔的字符--不要在代码中硬编码用于表示换行字符

rules.name: G.ERR.09 Do not call System.exit() to terminate the JVM
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.09 不要调用System.exit()终止JVM

rules.name: G.NAM.01 An identifier must contain a maximum of 64 characters, including letters, digits, and underscores (_)
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.01 标识符应由不超过64字符的字母、数字和下划线组成

rules.name: G.PRM.09 Do not use the Finalizer mechanism.
rules.nameCn: G.PRM.09 禁止使用Finalizer机制

rules.name: G.NAM.08 Boolean variables should start with auxiliary verbs
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.08 布尔型变量建议以表达是非意义的动词开头

rules.name: G.FMT.01 Source files (including comments) should be encoded in UTF-8 format
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.01 源文件编码格式（包括注释）应该是UTF-8

rules.name: G.CON.10 A thread should be interrupted by service code. Exercise caution when using the Thread.interrupt method
rules.nameCn: G.CON.10 线程中断由业务代码来协作完成，慎用Thread.interrupt方法

rules.name: G.ERR.08 Do not use return, break, or continue, or throw an exception to abruptly terminate the finally block--Throw from finally block
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.08 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束--在finally块中使用throw语句

rules.name: G.EDV.06 Prevent XML Entity Expansion (XEE) attacks caused by parsing external XML
rules.nameCn: G.EDV.06 防止解析来自外部的XML导致的内部实体扩展（XML Entity Expansion）攻击

rules.name: G.PRM.04 Do not precompile regexes repeatedly
rules.nameCn: G.PRM.04 不要对正则表达式进行频繁重复预编译

rules.name: G.MET.01 Methods should be short--code block nesting layers less than 4
rules.nameCn: G.MET.01 方法要简短--方法的代码块嵌套深度不应超过4层

rules.name: G.TYP.03 Do not use floating-point numbers as loop counters
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.03 禁止使用浮点数作为循环计数器

rules.name: G.COL.04 Do not modify the collection by performing remove() / add() on elements in a foreach loop
rules.nameCn: G.COL.04 不要在foreach循环中通过remove()/add()方法更改集合

rules.name: G.EDV.05 Prevent XML External Entity (XXE) attacks caused by parsing external XML
rules.nameCn: G.EDV.05 防止解析来自外部的XML导致的外部实体（XML External Entity）攻击

rules.name: G.PRM.02 Use System.arraycopy() or Arrays.copyOf() to copy arrays
rules.nameCn: G.PRM.02 使用System.arraycopy()或Arrays.copyOf()进行数组复制

rules.name: G.EXP.03 Use the same type for the second and third operands in the ?: conditional expression
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.03 条件表达式?:的第2和第3个操作数应使用相同的类型

rules.name: G.TYP.04 Use BigDecimal instead of float or double when precise calculation is required
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.04 需要精确计算时使用BigDecimal，不要使用float和double

rules.name: G.OBJ.02 Do not call methods that may be overridden by child classes in constructors of parent classes
rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.02 不要在父类的构造方法中调用可能被子类覆写的方法

rules.name: G.ERR.08 Do not use return, break, or continue, or throw an exception to abruptly terminate the finally block--Return from finally block
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.08 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束--在finally块中使用return语句

rules.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--insecure AES mode
rules.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--AES使用不安全的ECB操作模式

rules.name: G.PRM.01 Use the Collection<T>.toArray(T[]) method to convert collections into arrays (use Collection<T>.toArray(IntFunction<T[]>) for Java 11 and later versions)
rules.nameCn: G.PRM.01 将集合转为数组时使用Collection<T>.toArray(T[])方法；Java 11后使用Collection<T>.toArray(IntFunction<T[]>)

rules.name: G.CTL.03 A switch statement must have a default branch
rules.nameCn: G.CTL.03 switch语句要有default分支

rules.name: G.TYP.06 Do not compare against NaN. Use the isNaN() method of the Double or Float class to determine whether the value is NaN
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.06 禁止尝试与NaN进行比较运算，相等操作使用Double或Float的isNaN()方法

rules.name: G.CTL.01 Do not assign values or conduct complex condition judgment in controlling conditional expressions
rules.nameCn: G.CTL.01 不要在控制性条件表达式中执行赋值操作或执行复杂的条件判断

rules.name: G.FMT.16 If 'break' is not added to the end of the case statement block, comments should be provided (fall-through)
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.16 case语句块结束时如果不加break，需要有注释说明(fall-through)

rules.name: G.SEC.01 Declare the security check method private or final
rules.nameCn: G.SEC.01 进行安全检查的方法必须声明为private或final

rules.name: G.CMT.05 File header comments should contain the copyright notice
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.05 文件头注释应该包含版权许可信息

rules.name: G.TYP.05 Do not directly use == to determine the equivalence of floating point data. Do not use equals() or flt.compareTo(another) == 0 to compare floating-point boxed primitives
rules.nameCn: G.TYP.05 浮点型数据判断相等不要直接使用==，浮点型包装类型不要用equals()或者 flt.compareTo(another) == 0作相等的比较

rules.name: G.CTL.02 An else branch should be added at the end of the else if statement
rules.nameCn: G.CTL.02 含else if分支的条件判断应在最后加一个else分支

rules.name: G.FMT.02 A source file contains the copyright notice, package, import, and top-level class in sequence, which are separated by blank lines
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.02 一个源文件按顺序包含版权、package、import、顶层类，且用空行分隔

rules.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--RSA without padding
rules.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--RSA未使用填充模式

rules.name: G.FMT.15 Separate enumeration constants by commas (,), with or without line breaks
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.15 枚举常量间用逗号隔开， 换行可选

rules.name: G.DCL.05 Do not declare mutable objects as public static final
rules.nameCn: G.DCL.05 禁止将mutable对象声明为public static final

rules.name: G.FMT.04 Declarations of a class or interface should appear in the sequence of class variables, static initialization blocks, instance variables, instance initialization blocks, constructors, and methods, and separated by blank lines
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.04 一个类或接口的声明部分应该按照类变量、静态初始化块、实例变量、实例初始化块、构造器、方法的顺序出现，且用空行分隔

rules.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--key length is less than the specified length
rules.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--密钥长度少于指定长度

rules.name: G.CMT.03 The Javadoc for methods should contain function descriptions. Use @param, @return, and @throws in sequence to add comments for parameters, return values, and exceptions if necessary--There should be a blank line between the function description and the label
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.03 方法的Javadoc中应该包含功能说明，根据实际需要按顺序使用@param、@return、@throws标签对参数、返回值、异常进行注释--功能描述和标签之间要有一个空行

rules.name: G.FMT.14 Redundant spaces should not be inserted for vertical alignment
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.14 不应插入多余空格使代码垂直对齐

rules.name: G.EXP.01 Do not assign the same variable more than once in one expression
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.01 不要在单个表达式中对相同的变量赋值超过一次

rules.name: G.CMT.06 There should be a blank line or space between the comment and the code, and a space between the comment character and the comment content
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.06 注释与代码之间应该有空行或空格，注释符与注释内容之间应该有空格

rules.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--weak encryption algorithms
rules.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--弱加密算法

rules.name: G.EXP.05 Do not use a null in any case where an object is required to prevent null pointer reference
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.05 禁止直接使用可能为null的对象，防止出现空指针引用

rules.name: G.FMT.13 Use spaces to highlight keywords and important information
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.13 用空格突出关键字和重要信息

rules.name: G.FIO.02 Perform security check when decompressing a ZIP archive using ZipInputStream
rules.nameCn: G.FIO.02 从ZipInputStream中解压文件必须进行安全检查

rules.name: G.CMT.07 No TODO/FIXME comments should be contained in the code delivered to customers
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.07 正式交付给客户的代码不应包含TODO/FIXME注释

rules.name: Rule-9.3 Use hash algorithm with salted value to store passwords safely--salt hardcoded
rules.nameCn: 规则-9.3 基于哈希算法的口令安全存储必须加入盐值（salt）--盐值硬编码

rules.name: G.ERR.04 Prevent sensitive information leakage caused by exceptions
rules.nameCn: G.ERR.04 防止通过异常泄露敏感信息

rules.name: G.FMT.12 Reduce unnecessary blank lines to keep the code compact
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.12 减少不必要的空行，保持代码紧凑

rules.name: G.EXP.04 When comparing expressions--expression left side tends to change and the right side tends to remain unchanged
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.04 表达式的比较，应该遵循左侧倾向于变化、右侧倾向于不变的原则--表达式比较左变右不变

rules.name: G.OTH.03 Delete unused code segments instead of commenting them out--remove unused code lines
rules.nameCn: G.OTH.03 不用的代码段包括import，直接删除，不要注释掉--不用的代码段，直接删除，不要注释掉

rules.name: Rule-9.3 Use hash algorithm with salted value to store passwords safely--hash iteration count
rules.nameCn: 规则-9.3 基于哈希算法的口令安全存储必须加入盐值（salt）--Hash迭代不充分

rules.name: Unsafe TLS protocol
rules.nameCn: 规则2.6.1 禁止使用SSL2.0、SSL3.0、TLS1.0、TLS1.1协议

rules.name: G.EXP.02 Use parentheses to specify the operation sequence of expressions, thereby avoiding excessive dependence on the default priority
rules.nameCn: G.EXP.02 用括号明确表达式的操作顺序，避免过分依赖默认优先级

rules.name: G.OTH.03 Delete unused code segments instead of commenting them out--remove unused import
rules.nameCn: G.OTH.03 不用的代码段包括import，直接删除，不要注释掉--不用的import语句，直接删除，不要注释掉

rules.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--insecure hash algorithms
rules.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--不安全的哈希算法

rules.name: Android:Pass Explicit Intents to PendingIntent
rules.nameCn: 规则6.3 使用PENDINGINTENT触发事件时须传入显式INTENT

rules.name: G.FMT.11 Line feeds should be placed before operators
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.11 建议换行起点在操作符之前

rules.name: G.SER.01 Do not implement the Serializable interface if possible
rules.nameCn: G.SER.01 尽量避免实现Serializable接口

rules.name: G.CMT.04 Do not write empty-content method header comments
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.04 不写空有格式的方法头注释

rules.name: G.FIO.03 Use return values of the int type for methods that read a character or byte from a stream
rules.nameCn: G.FIO.03 对于从流中读取一个字符或字节的方法，使用int类型的返回值

rules.name: Weak encryption inadquate length for HMAC256
rules.nameCn: 建议2.6.5 SSH协议优先选择ECC密钥交换算法和身份认证公钥算法，优先选择HMAC-SHA2消息认证算法

rules.name: G.FMT.10 Each line contains a maximum of 120 narrow characters
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.10 行宽不超过120个窄字符

rules.name: G.CMT.02 The Javadoc of the top-level public class should contain the function description and creation date/version information
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.02 顶层public类的Javadoc应该包含功能说明和创建日期/版本信息

rules.name: G.OTH.01 Use cryptographically secure random numbers in security scenarios
rules.nameCn: G.OTH.01 安全场景下必须使用密码学意义上的安全随机数

rules.name: Improper HTTPS cookie secure attribute
rules.nameCn: 建议5.5 为cookie设置secure标志

rules.name: G.FMT.09 Each line contains one statement only
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.09 每行不超过一个语句

rules.name: G.CON.12 Use a thread pool to control resources and to prevent excessive creation of new threads
rules.nameCn: G.CON.12 避免不加控制地创建新线程，应该使用线程池来管控资源

rules.name: G.SER.04 Do not directly serialize information pointing to system resources
rules.nameCn: G.SER.04 禁止直接序列化指向系统资源的信息

rules.name: G.CON.01 Avoid synchronization pitfalls when implementing synchronization control on shared variables--Forbid instance lock share static data
rules.nameCn: G.CON.01 对共享变量做同步访问控制时需避开同步陷阱--不要使用实例锁来保护静态共享数据

rules.name: G.EDV.04 Do not directly use external data to concatenate XML
rules.nameCn: G.EDV.04 禁止直接使用外部数据来拼接XML

rules.name: G.FMT.07 Avoid empty blocks
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.07 应该避免空块，必须使用空块时，应采用统一的大括号换行风格

rules.name: G.CON.08 Use the setUncaughtExceptionHandler() method of the thread object to register handlers of uncaught exceptions
rules.nameCn: G.CON.08 使用Thread对象的setUncaughtExceptionHandler方法注册未捕获异常处理者

rules.name: G.CMT.01 Javadoc comments should be present for every public or protected element
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.01 public或protected修饰的元素应添加Javadoc注释

rules.name: G.OTH.04 Do not include public network addresses in code
rules.nameCn: G.OTH.04 禁止代码中包含公网地址

rules.name: G.EDV.02 Do not use external data to construct format strings
rules.nameCn: G.EDV.02 禁止直接使用外部数据构造格式化字符串

rules.name: G.FMT.08 Use spaces to indent
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.08 使用空格进行缩进，每次缩进4个空格

rules.name: G.CON.06 Use new concurrency utilities to replace wait() and notify()
rules.nameCn: G.CON.06 使用新并发工具代替wait()和notify()

rules.name: G.CMT.03 The Javadoc for methods should contain function descriptions. Use @param, @return, and @throws in sequence to add comments for parameters, return values, and exceptions if necessary
rules.nameCn: G.CMT.03 方法的Javadoc中应该包含功能说明，根据实际需要按顺序使用@param、@return、@throws标签对参数、返回值、异常进行注释

rules.name: G.CON.13 Clear custom ThreadLocal variables when the thread in the thread pool ends
rules.nameCn: G.CON.13 线程池中的任务结束后必须清理其自定义的ThreadLocal变量

rules.name: G.FMT.06 For a non-empty block structure, the opening brace should be placed at the end of a line, and the closing brace should be placed in a new line
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.06 对于非空块状结构，左大括号应该放在行尾，右大括号应该另起一行

rules.name: G.CON.07 Name a thread when creating it
rules.nameCn: G.CON.07 创建新线程时必须指定线程名

rules.name: G.NAM.06 Name variables in lowerCamelCase style
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.06 变量采用小驼峰命名

rules.name: G.FIO.01 Validate and canonicalize path names constructed using external data
rules.nameCn: G.FIO.01 使用外部数据构造的文件路径前必须进行校验，校验前必须对文件路径进行规范化处理

rules.name: G.FMT.05 Braces should be used in conditional statements and loop blocks
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.05 在条件语句和循环块中应该使用大括号

rules.name: G.OBJ.10 Remove redundant modifiers from interface definitions
rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.10 接口定义中去掉多余的修饰词

rules.name: G.NAM.07 Avoid using Boolean variable names with negative meanings
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.07 避免使用具有否定含义布尔变量名

rules.name: G.FIO.04 Do not let external processes block on input and output streams
rules.nameCn: G.FIO.04 防止外部进程阻塞在输入输出流上

rules.name: P.05 Validate external data before using it--Trust boundary violation
rules.nameCn: P.05 外部数据使用前必须进行合法性校验--信任边界场景

rules.name: G.FMT.20 A proper suffix should be set for the numeric literal, and the long type should use L as the suffix
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.20 数字字面量应该设置合适的后缀，long类型应该使用L作为后缀

rules.name: G.OBJ.08 Correctly implement the singleton pattern
rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.08 正确实现单例模式

rules.name: G.NAM.05 Capitalize a constant name, with each word separated by an underscore (_)
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.05 常量名采用全大写单词，单词间以下划线分隔

rules.name: G.SEC.02 Configure a custom class loader to invoke the getPermission() method of the parent class before overriding a getPermission() method
rules.nameCn: G.SEC.02 自定义类加载器覆写getPermission() 时，必须先调用父类的getPermission() 方法

rules.name: G.EDV.01 Do not directly use external data to concatenate SQL statements
rules.nameCn: G.EDV.01 禁止直接使用外部数据来拼接SQL语句

rules.name: G.FMT.19 Class and member modifiers (if present) appear in the order recommended by the Java specification
rules.nameCn: G.FMT.19 类和成员修饰符（如果存在）按Java语言规范建议的顺序显示

rules.name: G.OBJ.09 Use class names instead of instances or expressions to call static methods
rules.nameCn: G.OBJ.09 使用类名调用静态方法，而不要使用实例或表达式来调用

rules.name: G.NAM.04 Methods should be named in lowerCamelCase style
rules.nameCn: G.NAM.04 方法名应采用小驼峰命名

rules.name: G.SER.07 Prevent deserialization from being used to bypass security operations
rules.nameCn: G.SER.07 防止反序列化被利用来绕过构造方法中的安全操作

rules.name: G.PRM.07 Release resources in try-with-resource or finally during I/O operations

rule.name: P.05 Validate external data before using it--LDAP injection
rule.nameCn: P.05 外部数据使用前必须进行合法性校验--LDAP注入场景

rule.name: G.EXP.04 When comparing expressions--Use equals method to compare strings
rule.nameCn: G.EXP.04 表达式的比较，应该遵循左侧倾向于变化、右侧倾向于不变的原则--使用equals方法进行字符串比较

rule.name: G.TYP.12 Use explicit type conversion rather than implicit type conversion
rule.nameCn: G.TYP.12 明确地进行类型转换，避免依赖隐式类型转换

rule.name: G.TYP.13 Use instanceof to check if the object belongs to the specific type before downcasting
rule.nameCn: G.TYP.13 在引用类型向下转换前用instanceof进行判断

rule.name: G.ERR.02 Do not directly catch base exception classes such as Throwable, Exception, and RuntimeException
rule.nameCn: G.ERR.02 不要直接捕获异常的基类Throwable、Exception、RuntimeException

rule.name: G.COL.03 Limit available generic types through qualifiers in a generic class declaration
rule.nameCn: G.COL.03 声明一个泛型类通过限定符限制可用的泛型类型

rule.name: G.DCL.03 Do not declare C-style arrays
rule.nameCn: G.DCL.03 禁止C风格的数组声明

rule.name: G.PRM.05 Do not create unnecessary objects
rule.nameCn: G.PRM.05 禁止创建不必要的对象

rule.name: G.TYP.11 Prefer primitive types to boxed primitives
rule.nameCn: G.TYP.11 基本类型优于包装类型，注意合理使用包装类型

rule.name: G.TYP.07 Do not hardcode the characters that indicate new lines and file path separators--hard-code file path separators
rule.nameCn: G.TYP.07 避免在代码中硬编码用于表示换行、文件路径分隔的字符--不要在代码中硬编码用于表示文件路径分隔的字符

rule.name: G.ERR.01 Do not use an empty catch block to ignore exceptions
rule.nameCn: G.ERR.01 不要通过一个空的catch块忽略异常

rule.name: G.ERR.04 Prevent sensitive information leakage caused by exceptions
rule.nameCn: G.ERR.04 防止通过异常泄露敏感信息

rule.name: G.DCL.01 Declare one variable in each line
rule.nameCn: G.DCL.01 每行声明一个变量

rule.name: G.PRM.10 Do not create a temporary variable as the return value of a return statement
rule.nameCn: G.PRM.10 不要创建临时变量作为return语句的返回值

rule.name: G.SER.02 Ensure that classes that can implement the Serializable interface support explicit declaration of serialVersionUID
rule.nameCn: G.SER.02 实现Serializable接口的可序列化类应该显式声明serialVersionUID
